responsibility: Declares the common enums, tables, and helper accessors that describe S/390 builtin types and builtin identifiers across the backend and front-end-facing intrinsic code. It exposes generated indices for base, function, and overloaded types, builtin code ranges for direct and overloaded intrinsics, flag lookup helpers, and the shared builtin declaration arrays used by s390-c.cc and builtin registration logic.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/s390/s390-builtins.def, this file is the typed interface layer that includes the .def table to generate enums and declare shared builtin arrays/accessors for other code; it does not list builtin entries itself, but exposes the generated identifiers and lookup API built from that table.
